paper_title: Constraints on axions from patchy screening of the cosmic microwave background
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: First measurement of cross-correlation between axion-induced CMB patchy screening maps (Planck NPIPE, constrained NILC with tSZ/CIB deprojection) and unWISE Blue galaxies. No signal detected; 95% CL upper limit g_agamma <~ 2e-12 GeV^-1 for 1e-13 eV <~ m_a <~ 1e-12 eV, encoded as a flat two-point bound over the stated validity range. This is an astrophysical/cosmological bound based on CMB photon-to-axion conversion in galactic halos, so it does NOT assume axions are dark matter (dm_density_assumed = null). The precise mass dependence of the exclusion curve (Fig. 3) is not tabulated in the text; only the approximate flat value is quoted, so the exact shape near the mass-range edges is not captured. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 38)) | Vision: Fig. 3 (page 4, top-right of fig_02.png) shows the 95% CL upper exclusion (red region) on g_agamma from cross-correlating axion-induced CMB screening (Planck) with unWISE Blue galaxies. Boundary traced from red region lower edge; minimum ~1.05e-12 GeV^-1 near m_a~3e-13 eV, rising to ~2e-12 at 1e-12 eV (matches abstract quote g<~2e-12 GeV^-1 for 1e-13<m_a<1e-12 eV). Region closes against CAST bound (~6.6e-11) at both ends. Not a dark-matter search, so no DM density assumption.
